_comment: UrNetwork provider egg for full-bars/urnetwork-3.23-fix. Updates are owned by the image (re-pull); runtime self-update is disabled inside the container.
name: UrNetwork (full-bars 3.23-fix)
author: klets
description: URnetwork provider (hardened fork). Accepts stable, nightly, or jwt mode. Credentials stay admin-only.

variables.name: BUILD
variables.description: Startup mode. stable = tested release; nightly = development snapshot built from main; jwt = authenticate with an auth code instead of user/password (requires AUTHCODE).

variables.name: Email or phone
variables.description: Your URnetwork account email or phone. Required for BUILD=stable and BUILD=nightly. Ignored for BUILD=jwt.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: Account password for USER_AUTH. Required for BUILD=stable and BUILD=nightly. Admin-only: users cannot view this value in the panel.

variables.name: Auth code
variables.description: One-time authentication code from https://ur.io for passwordless login. Required when BUILD=jwt. Admin-only.

variables.name: Pelican mode
variables.description: Signal for the container that it runs under a panel. Do not change: also disables runtime binary updates so the image stays the single source of truth.

variables.name: Traffic monitor
variables.description: vnStat web UI on port 8080. Disabled by default for security (it exposes fleet traffic without authentication). Enable only via a custom image build.

variables.name: IP checker
variables.description: Diagnostic that prints the container's full public IP to the console at startup. Off by default.
